ruling: F-A2 (Q-L1-01): chart_divisionals unique key gains fact_subject (seven columns)
description: F-A2 (PR #2858; migrations 1222 / 1223; D6 owner-path plan; ga_vargas writer). The chart_divisionals unique index and the data-plane capture trigger gain a seventh column, fact_subject, so rows that differ only in fact_subject no longer collide on one stored row (under the six-column key ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING silently kept only the first). Derived from the F-A2 spec (F_A2_KEY_WIDENING_D6_PLAN_v1_0.md section 3 table and section 8 acceptance criteria C1 to C7) and the ga_vargas writer's row builders, NOT from a run. Spec, canonical chart, stored rows: 24,392 -> 38,596 = +14,204 = varga_ashtakavarga +13,200 (5 ayanamshas x 30 vargas x 8 labels [7 grahas + SARVA] = 1,200 keys, each 1 -> 12 rows, one per sign) + varga_house_lord +750 (12 houses over 7 lords: the five two-sign lords gain a second row, 5 x 30 x 5 = 750 keys) + varga_d30_lord_per_amsa +250 (10 lord/degree keys per ayanamsha x 5 = 50 keys, each 1 -> 6) + scope_cap +4 (the ALL_VARGAS sentinel key 1 -> 5; stored 2 -> 6). No other category changes its row count and no existing row is removed. DETECTOR VIEW: the detector keys chart_divisionals rows by (ayanamsha, varga, graha, category, fact_key) and counts a changed key once, so the row-level gains read as occurrence_count changes: ashtakavarga 1,200, house_lord 750, d30 50, scope_cap 1. The ashtakavarga entry additionally reads 1,200 VALUE changes that are a pairing artifact, not real value changes: the single surviving old row of each key is sign Aries (S1, first written), and the detector pairs it with the alphabetically first of the twelve new rows (Aquarius), whatever the bindu numbers are; the old Aries row itself is unchanged. house_lord and d30 pair with no value change because the survivor is also the first sorted row (lowest house; identical lord/start-degree text and number across signs). The scope_cap entry is also declared by ga_vargas_invariant_sentinels.json (#2960); both count the same change. Canonical chart only: other charts hold stale generations (S-L1b).
